field_definitions.scientific_judgment_available: Original authored scientific judgment available, including diagnostic or HOLD; not full coverage or formal/timely delivery.
field_definitions.review_formal_output_delivery: Original formal required output delivery disposition, distinct from scientific authorship.
field_definitions.review_actual_timely_delivery: Exact original flag for review delivery within actual original allowance; no elapsed arithmetic.
field_definitions.full_scientific_coverage: Entire declared bounded scientific-content assessment, independent of grade, history and empirical execution.
field_definitions.full_declared_primary_source_coverage: Exact original declared source-assessment extent or predeclared source-scoped equivalent. Unverified original source obligations remain separate and cannot become PASS.
field_definitions.native_pipeline_qualified: Original pipeline qualification only; terminal completion does not imply active observation or native eligibility.
field_definitions.method_eligible: Original matched method credit/eligibility separate from science, time and provenance.
field_definitions.normalized_material_count: Original count only in its assessed scope; C01 unassessed count0 is retained original and normalized null.

transformations.explicit_bool: Only original JSON true/false, otherwise UNKNOWN.
transformations.enum_bool: Only finite exact declared original enum with byte-bound source semantics; no substring, counts, axis or terminal coverage inference.
transformations.string_only: Original string unchanged; null retained without manufactured grade.
transformations.declared_identity_present: Original candidate delivery identity presence only, no quality/native inference and no artifact-body reads.
transformations.record_reference: Preserve exact original source bytes/hash/pointer as reference-only context/history/economics.
transformations.constant_bound: Frozen non-scientific reporting binding to original index/config.
transformations.unassessed_material_null: Normalize unassessed material count to null, retain original0 separately.
transformations.unknown: Explicit unresolved mapping with exact source pointer and reason.
transformations.all_three_valued: false if any explicit false, true if all explicit true, otherwise UNKNOWN.
transformations.paired_values: Ordered original control,treatment values, never a grade.

edition_selection: Fixed historical final-authorized editions; M07A original closed v3 added. No best-of, new versions, dynamic current path or reopening held science.
